Load packages:

```{r}
#| message: false
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
```

File paths: 

```{r}
fp_cee = "~/../../Volumes/subseasonal_extreme/"
```

Load proportion of variances:

```{r}
prop_var <-
  read.csv(paste0(
    fp_cee, "weekly_ave_test/input_explained_variance.csv"
  ))
```

Load variables used in model training:

```{r}
# Variables identified by Maike as redundant
redundant_cols <-
  c(
    'slp_weekave_atlantic_ocean_mean',
    'h_850_weekave_conus_mean',
    'h_850_weekave_atlantic_ocean_pc4',
    'h_850_weekave_mexico_gulf_mean',
    'slp_weekave_mexico_gulf_mean',
    'slp_weekave_conus_pc1',
    'ts_weekave_conus_pc1',
    'slp_weekave_atlantic_trop_mean',
    'ts_weekave_southern_canada_pc1',
    't_850_weekave_southern_canada_mean',
    'h_850_weekave_atlantic_ocean_pc5',
    'slp_weekave_atlantic_ocean_pc6',
    'h_500_weekave_pacific_trop_mean',
    'h_850_weekave_atlantic_trop_mean',
    't_500_weekave_pacific_trop_mean',
    't_500_weekave_atlantic_trop_pc1',
    'h_850_weekave_pacific_ocean_pc1',
    't_850_weekave_conus_pc1',
    'slp_weekave_atlantic_ocean_pc1',
    'slp_weekave_pacific_trop_mean',
    't_850_weekave_southern_canada_pc1',
    'h_850_weekave_arctic_pc1',
    'h_500_weekave_atlantic_trop_mean',
    'h_850_weekave_atlantic_ocean_pc2',
    'slp_weekave_atlantic_ocean_pc3',
    'h_850_weekave_atlantic_ocean_pc7',
    't_500_weekave_mexico_gulf_mean',
    't_500_weekave_southern_canada_pc1',
    'slp_weekave_pacific_trop_pc2',
    'h_850_weekave_arctic_mean',
    'ts_weekave_atlantic_trop_mean',
    'h_850_weekave_pacific_trop_mean'
  )

# Input Climate Data
climate_inputs <-
  readr::read_csv(
    paste0(fp_cee, "weekly_ave_test/weekly_aves_regional_inputs_1980_2024.csv"), 
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ) |>
  mutate(date = as.character(date)) |>
  separate(date, into = c("year", "week"), sep = 4, remove = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    year = as.numeric(year),
    week = as.numeric(week)
  ) |>
  select(-all_of(redundant_cols))
```

Extract variable names used in model training:

```{r}
model_vars <-
  data.frame(
    var = climate_inputs |> select(-date, -year, -week) |> names()
  ) |> 
  arrange(var) |>
  mutate(var = str_remove(var, "_mean")) |> 
  mutate(var = str_remove_all(
    var,  paste0("\\b", str_c(paste0("_pc", 1:20), collapse = "|"), "\\b")
  )) |> 
  mutate(var = str_remove(var, "_pc1")) |> 
  mutate(var = str_remove(var, "0+$")) |>
  mutate(var = str_remove(var, "weekave_")) |>
  distinct()
```

Subset proportion of variance to only variables used in model training:

```{r}
prop_var_modeled <-
  prop_var |> 
  rename_all(.funs = tolower) |>
  select(pc_num, model_vars$var)
```

Compute cumulative proportion of variances that are correct:

```{r}
prop_var_cumu_modeled <-
  prop_var_modeled |> mutate_at(.vars = vars(-pc_num), .funs = cumsum)
```

Plot proportion of varianc by PC:

```{r}
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 16
prop_var_modeled |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -pc_num) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = pc_num, y = value)) + 
  geom_col() + 
  facet_wrap(. ~ name)
```

Plot cumulative proportion of varianc by PC:

```{r}
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 16
prop_var_cumu_modeled |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -pc_num) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = pc_num, y = value)) + 
  geom_col() + 
  facet_wrap(. ~ name)
```

Extract the cumulative proportion of variance for the 20th PCs:

```{r}
prop_var_cumu_calc_20 <-
  prop_var_cumu_modeled |>
  filter(pc_num == 20) |> 
  select(-pc_num) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(), 
    names_to = "variable", 
    values_to = "prop_var_cumu"
  )
```

Compute statistics of the cumulative proportion of variance for the 20th PCs:

```{r}
paste0("Mean: ", round(100*mean(prop_var_cumu_calc_20$prop_var_cumu), 2), "%")
paste0("Median: ", round(100*median(prop_var_cumu_calc_20$prop_var_cumu), 2), "%")
paste0("Minimum: ", round(100*min(prop_var_cumu_calc_20$prop_var_cumu), 2), "%")
paste0("Maximum: ", round(100*max(prop_var_cumu_calc_20$prop_var_cumu), 2), "%")
```

Plot of the cumulative proportions of variance for the 20th PCs:

```{r}
prop_var_cumu_calc_20 |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = prop_var_cumu)) + 
  geom_histogram(bins = 40)
```
